e.title: 餐饮保险智能报价器：公众责任险／食品安全责任险／雇主责任险三类中文险种的规则报价 MVP，规则数据带版本号
e.title_en: A Chinese restaurant-insurance quoting MVP covering public liability, food-safety liability and employer liability, with rule data carrying an explicit version number
e.title_hk: 餐飲保險智能報價器：公眾責任險／食品安全責任險／雇主責任險三類中文險種的規則報價 MVP，規則數據帶版本號
e.summary: 一个面向中国餐饮企业的移动端保费预估工具：三类真实商业险种（公众责任险、食品安全责任险、雇主责任险）可单选或组合报价，按经营面积自动匹配保费系数，雇主责任险按保障方案、岗位人数与八人起保门槛计算；报价引擎是与界面解耦的纯 TypeScript 模块且规则数据按版本管理，结果区分正常报价、部分报价、人工报价与不符合承保条件四种状态
e.summary_hk: 一個面向中國餐飲企業的移動端保費預估工具：三類真實商業險種（公眾責任險、食品安全責任險、雇主責任險）可單選或組合報價，按經營面積自動匹配保費係數，雇主責任險按保障方案、崗位人數與八人起保門檻計算；報價引擎是與界面解耦的純 TypeScript 模組且規則數據按版本管理，結果區分正常報價、部分報價、人工報價與不符合承保條件四種狀態
e.summary_en: A mobile premium estimation tool for Chinese restaurant businesses: three real commercial lines (public liability, food-safety liability and employer liability) can be quoted individually or in combination, with premium coefficients matched automatically by operating area and employer liability computed from the protection plan, headcount per role and a minimum eight-person underwriting threshold; the quoting engine is a pure TypeScript module decoupled from the UI, its rule data is managed by version, and results distinguish four states — normal quote, partial quote, manual quote and not eligible for underwriting
e.body:
**restaurant-insurance-quote**（餐饮保险智能报价器）是一个**面向中国餐饮企业的移动端保费预估工具**（仓库 `BenjaminNH/restaurant-insurance-quote`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 1,356 KB、创建于 2026-09-07、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，均落在解冻窗口或其之后**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 未出现于其文档结构，且 README 对此有**明确声明**——见下方标注 ①）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 3,310 字节（中文）**。**已实测存在的关键文件**：**`package.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md`**（**该两个中文名文档经 raw 探测实测 HTTP 200**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「把边界写成清单」**中的**第一种，也是**中文险种**在这批候选中最集中的一条**（**本站此前多轮词条均以「是否有中文材料未核实」收尾，本条整条为中文且险种名即为中文实务名称**）。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其定位逐字为**：**「一个面向餐饮企业客户的移动端保险保费预估工具。用户可以选择**公众责任险、食品安全责任险和雇主责任险**方案，填写单一门店及员工人数信息，快速获得标准规则下的预估保费。」**；**并逐字说明当前形态为**：**「当前项目为可独立运行的 **MVP 静态前端**，重点验证移动端报价流程、规则计算和**异常报价状态**。」**。**其核心功能逐字实测**：**「三类险种可独立选择，也可组合报价。」**；**「公众责任险和食品安全责任险**根据经营面积自动匹配保费系数**。」**；**「雇主责任险根据保障方案、岗位人数和**最低 8 人承保门槛**计算。」**；**「支持**正常报价、部分报价、人工报价和不符合承保条件**等结果状态。」**；**「展示**责任限额、免赔条件、投保资料**和对应的处理提示。」**；**「使用会话草稿保存填写进度，刷新页面后可继续操作。」**；**「针对移动端输入、软键盘遮挡、底部安全区域和触摸操作进行了适配。」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **三条中文险种名与它们的报价维度逐字实测，是本条目对中国保险实务学生最直接有用的一处**——**公众责任险（按经营面积匹配系数）**、**食品安全责任险（同按经营面积）**、**雇主责任险（按保障方案、岗位人数与**最低 8 人承保门槛**）**。⭐⭐ **「八人起保」这一门槛本身是一条**具体的承保实务约束****（**雇主责任险通常对小规模雇主设最低投保人数**），**而「按经营面积匹配保费系数」则是**场所类责任险的典型费率结构**；**对不熟悉中国商业险条款的学生，这三点是把**险种—风险暴露—费率驱动因素**串起来的最小样本**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这三个险种的费率结构在中国市场上确如此**——**本次未查任何保险公司条款或监管费率表**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「报价引擎采用与 UI 解耦的纯 TypeScript 模块，规则数据按版本管理」是本条目在工程上最值得记的一句**——**逐字见上**（**原文为「报价引擎采用与 UI 解耦的纯 TypeScript 模块，规则数据按版本管理」**）。⭐⭐ **这句话同时含两个要点**：**① **引擎与界面解耦**——使规则可被单独测试与替换**；**② **规则数据按版本管理**——使「这次报价用的是哪一版规则」成为可回答的问题****。**其 README 另逐字给出**当前规则版本为 `mvp-1.1`**，**并直接链接两份可打开的文件**：【保费规则说明】（`docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md`）与【结构化规则配置】（`docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json`）**⭐⭐ **而这两份文件**经 raw 探测实测确实存在（HTTP 200）****——**即「规则说明」与「机器可读的规则数据」同时公开**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读该两份文件的内容**——**本次只核实其存在**；**故**不转述任何保费公式、系数取值或承保边界**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **四种结果状态中「人工报价」与「不符合承保条件」是本轮主题的核心样本**——**逐字为「支持**正常报价、部分报价、人工报价和不符合承保条件**等结果状态」**⭐⭐ **即报价系统**不是只有「给出价格」一条出路****：**它可以**报一部分**（部分报价）、**转人工**（人工报价）、**或直接说明不可承保**（不符合承保条件）**——**这与本站连续多轮出现的同一条纪律同源**（**第 329 轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 flagging-not-blocking、第 331 轮 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的抑制误报、**本轮 [[insurance-rag-assistant]] 的 `answer_status`、以及 [[claimlens]] 的四类状态**）；**本条的特殊之处在于它把这套状态**用在报价环节**而非核保或理赔环节**——**即**在客户还只是问价时就说清「这个不能按标准规则报」****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该四态设计符合任何保险公司的实际报价流程**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「当前限制」一节逐字列了五条，是本轮主题最直接的形态**——**其一**：**「MVP 仅支持**单一门店**报价，不处理多门店合并报价。」**；**其二**：**「员工年龄条件在正式投保时核验，**当前页面不采集员工年龄明细**。」**；**其三**：**「尚未接入客户留资、数据库、员工个性化配置或管理后台。」**；**其四**：**「报价计算在**浏览器端**完成；**未来保存报价时需要由服务端按输入和规则版本重新计算**。」**；**其五**：**「结果页显示的业务手机号为**演示号码**，不能作为正式咨询渠道。」**⭐⭐⭐ **第四条尤其值得单独记住**：**它指出**客户端算出的价格若被保存，就必须由服务端按「输入＋规则版本」重算****——**即**防止客户端报价被当作权威记录****；**对做保险系统的同学，这是一条**很容易被忽略却直接影响可审计性**的设计约束**（**可与第 331 轮 [[paco-uw]] 的「改规则会改变过去报价的重新求值结果」并读——**两者都在处理**报价与规则版本的时间关系****）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **免责声明逐字，且把「替代什么」列得很具体**——**「本项目**仅用于咨询阶段的保费预估**，**不替代保险核心系统、正式核保或正式出单**。最终承保范围、保费及条款**以保险公司审核和正式保单为准**。」**⭐⭐ **三点合起来界定了**这份估算不能用于什么****（**不替代核心系统、不替代核保、不替代出单**）；**对做报价系统的学生，这是**把「输出不是承诺」写成业务语言**的样本**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其免责声明在任何辖区具有法律效力**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **技术栈与工程配置逐字且可核实**：**Next.js App Router、React、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS、React Hook Form、Zod、**Vitest、Playwright****；**两条命令逐字**：**`npm run check`（**lint、类型检查、单元测试与静态构建**）**与 **`npm run test:e2e`（端到端测试）**；**静态构建产物生成在 `out/`**，**可部署到任何静态托管**；⭐ **即**单元测试与端到端测试分开，且静态构建被纳入 `check`****（**⚠️ 本词条**未运行任何一条**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **移动端适配逐字实测且列出了具体处理项**：**「针对移动端输入、软键盘遮挡、底部安全区域和触摸操作进行了适配」**——⭐ **「软键盘遮挡」与「底部安全区域」是**真实移动端报价流程中会实际出问题**的两处**（**对做保险移动端的同学，这类细节通常不在需求文档里而在上线后才被发现**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **文档结构逐字实测，含三份设计文档**：**「技术选型」（技术架构、静态导出方案及后续演进方向）**、**「MVP 开发与验收」（当前功能范围、测试方式与已知限制）**、**「移动端 UX 设计说明」（移动端信息层级和交互设计原则）**，**另有「保费规则说明」与「结构化规则配置」**⭐⭐ **对做课程项目的学生，这套**功能范围／测试方式／已知限制**三件事并列的交付文档是一种可直接照搬的结构**。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站报价引擎与中文保险条目并读**：[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[insurance-pricing-demo]]、[[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]]、[[ruc-nonlife-actuarial]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **许可情形在本条属**第三种形态**，且是作者**主动写明**的**：**README 末节逐字为**：**「**本仓库当前未附加开源许可证。公开内容仅供查看与交流，未经许可不得复制、修改或分发。**」**——**即**不只是「沉默」，而是**明确声明保留全部权利**（**⚠️ 本词条据此提示：**复制、修改或分发该仓库内容均需先获授权****；**⚠️ 这与本站此前记录的两种形态不同**：第 330／331 轮的 [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、[[insurerisk]]、[[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 等属「**声称许可而无许可文件**」（**声明与实际不一致**），而 [[claim-ops]] 与 [[paco-uw]] 属「**完全未声明**」，**本条是**明确声明无许可****——**三者的使用者风险相近，但本条的可判断性最高**）；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README（3,310 字节）全文的定位段、核心功能六条、技术栈、运行与测试命令、业务规则与免责声明、当前限制五条、相关文档索引与许可声明**，**并以 raw 探测确认 `package.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md` 均存在（HTTP 200）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未 `npm install`、未运行 `npm run dev`／`check`／`test:e2e`、未读 `docs/` 下**任何文件的内容**（**含规则说明与规则 JSON**）、未读任何组件源码、未查看其界面或在移动设备上试运行****，因此**不能转述其保费公式、系数取值、承保边界、状态判定条件或任何报价结果**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其「公众责任险与食品安全责任险按经营面积匹配系数」与「雇主责任险八人起保」是否与中国市场上任何保险公司的实际条款或费率一致**——**本次未查任何保险公司条款、监管费率表或行业示范条款**；**本词条只记录其在 README 中被如此描述**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其四种结果状态（正常／部分／人工／不符合承保条件）的判定规则与阈值**（**未读规则 JSON**）；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**「规则数据按版本管理」的实际实现**（**其 README 自述当前版本为 `mvp-1.1`**）；**亦未核实**「报价引擎与 UI 解耦」在代码中是否成立**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「未读的两份中文规则文件」的完整性与准确性**——**⚠️ 其存在经 raw 探测确认为 200，但内容本次未读**；**⑦ ⭐ **未核实**其移动端适配项（软键盘遮挡、底部安全区域）是否确实生效**；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**其静态构建是否可成功产出 `out/`**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **其「业务手机号为演示号码」**已由作者声明；**本词条**不主张**该页面可用于任何真实的客户咨询或留资**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **该项目自述为**MVP 静态前端、用于咨询阶段保费预估****，**且明确不替代核心系统、正式核保与出单**；**本词条据此**不主张**其可用于任何真实的报价、核保、承保或监管用途**；**⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ **其规则数据**可能随版本变化且为演示性质****——**本词条**不主张**其任一版本的规则可用于真实定价**；**⑫ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-09-07、推送于 2026-09-10**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑬ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑭ **README 为中文**——**本词条已如实记入，**本次未核实是否有英文或繁体版本**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/BenjaminNH/restaurant-insurance-quote` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可字段、★数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 topics）；README 3,310 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**`package.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md` 经 raw 探测确认存在（HTTP 200）**；**未克隆、未安装、未运行、未读文档内容与源码**。
e.body_hk:
**restaurant-insurance-quote**（餐飲保險智能報價器）是一個**面向中國餐飲企業的移動端保費預估工具**（倉庫 `BenjaminNH/restaurant-insurance-quote`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 TypeScript、體量 1,356 KB、創建於 2026-09-07、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**均落在解凍窗口或其之後**）；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件，且 README 對此有**明確聲明****；**無 topics**；**README 實測 3,310 位元組（中文）**。**已實測存在的關鍵文件**：**`package.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md`**（**兩個中文名文檔經 raw 探測實測 HTTP 200**）。本條目屬本輪主題**「把邊界寫成清單」**中的**第一種，也是**中文險種**在這批候選中最集中的一條**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **定位逐字**：**「一个面向餐饮企业客户的移动端保险保费预估工具。用户可以选择**公众责任险、食品安全责任险和雇主责任险**方案，填写单一门店及员工人数信息，快速获得标准规则下的预估保费。」**；**並逐字說明當前形態**：**「当前项目为可独立运行的 **MVP 静态前端**，重点验证移动端报价流程、规则计算和**异常报价状态**。」**。**核心功能逐字**：「三类险种可独立选择，也可组合报价。」；**「公众责任险和食品安全责任险**根据经营面积自动匹配保费系数**。」**；**「雇主责任险根据保障方案、岗位人数和**最低 8 人承保门槛**计算。」**；**「支持**正常报价、部分报价、人工报价和不符合承保条件**等结果状态。」**；**「展示**责任限额、免赔条件、投保资料**和对应的处理提示。」**；**「使用会话草稿保存填写进度…」**；**「针对移动端输入、软键盘遮挡、底部安全区域和触摸操作进行了适配。」**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **三條中文險種名與其報價維度逐字，對中國保險實務學生最直接有用****：**公眾責任險（按經營面積匹配係數）**、**食品安全責任險（同）**、**雇主責任險（按保障方案、崗位人數與**最低 8 人承保門檻**）**⭐⭐ **「八人起保」是一條**具體的承保實務約束**，而「按經營面積匹配係數」是**場所類責任險的典型費率結構****（**⚠️ 不主張**這三個險種的費率結構在中國市場上確如此**——**未查任何保險公司條款或監管費率表**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「報價引擎採用與 UI 解耦的純 TypeScript 模組，規則數據按版本管理」是工程上最值得記的一句****⭐⭐ **含兩個要點**：①引擎與界面解耦；②**規則數據按版本管理**，使「這次報價用的是哪一版規則」成為可回答的問題**。**其 README 另逐字給出**當前規則版本 `mvp-1.1`**並直接連結【保費規則說明】與【結構化規則配置】兩份文件**⭐⭐ **該兩份文件經 raw 探測實測確實存在（HTTP 200）**——**即「規則說明」與「機器可讀的規則數據」同時公開**（**⚠️ 未讀其內容，故不轉述任何保費公式、係數取值或承保邊界**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **四種結果狀態中「人工報價」與「不符合承保條件」是本輪主題的核心樣本****⭐⭐ **即報價系統**不是只有「給出價格」一條出路****：**可報一部分、可轉人工、或直接說明不可承保**——**與本站連續多輪同一紀律同源**（**329 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 flagging-not-blocking、331 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]]、本輪 [[insurance-rag-assistant]] 的 answer_status、以及 [[claimlens]] 的四類狀態**）；**本條特殊之處在於把它**用在報價環節**——**在客戶還只是問價時就說清「這個不能按標準規則報」**（**⚠️ 不主張**該四態設計符合任何保險公司的實際報價流程**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「當前限制」五條逐字**：①僅支持**單一門店**報價；②**當前頁面不採集員工年齡明細**（正式投保時核驗）；③尚未接入客戶留資、資料庫、員工個性化配置或管理後台；④**「報價計算在**瀏覽器端**完成；**未來保存報價時需要由服務端按輸入和規則版本重新計算**」**；⑤業務手機號為**演示號碼****⭐⭐⭐ **第④條尤其值得單獨記住**：**客戶端算出的價格若被保存，就必須由服務端按「輸入＋規則版本」重算**——**即防止客戶端報價被當作權威記錄**（**可與第 331 輪 [[paco-uw]] 的「改規則會改變過去報價的重新求值結果」並讀**——**兩者都在處理**報價與規則版本的時間關係****）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **免責聲明逐字且把「替代什麼」列得具體**：**「本项目**仅用于咨询阶段的保费预估**，**不替代保险核心系统、正式核保或正式出单**。最终承保范围、保费及条款**以保险公司审核和正式保单为准**。」**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **技術棧與工程配置逐字**：Next.js App Router、React、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS、React Hook Form、Zod、**Vitest、Playwright**；**兩條命令**：`npm run check`（**lint、類型檢查、單元測試與靜態構建**）與 `npm run test:e2e`；**靜態構建產物生成在 `out/`****⭐ 即**單元測試與端到端測試分開，且靜態構建被納入 check****（**⚠️ 本次未運行任何一條**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[insurance-pricing-demo]]、[[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]]、[[ruc-nonlife-actuarial]]、[[insurance-governance]] 並讀**。

**restaurant-insurance-quote** is **a mobile premium estimation tool for Chinese restaurant businesses** (repository `BenjaminNH/restaurant-insurance-quote`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, TypeScript as the primary language, a 1,356 KB repository, created 2026-09-07 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, on or after the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file, and its README states this explicitly** (**see note ① below**); it has **no topics**; **the README measures 3,310 bytes and is in Chinese**. **Key files measurably present**: **`package.json`, `docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json` and `docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md`** (**both Chinese-named documents measured HTTP 200 by raw probe**). It is the first of this round’s four takes on **writing the boundary as a list**, **and the entry in this batch with the densest concentration of Chinese lines of business** (**earlier entries repeatedly closed with "whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified"; this one is entirely Chinese and its line names are the actual Chinese practice terms**).

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **its positioning reads verbatim**: **"A mobile insurance premium estimation tool for restaurant business clients. Users can select public liability, food-safety liability and employer liability plans, enter single-store and staff-count information, and quickly obtain an estimated premium under standard rules."**; **and it states its current form verbatim**: **"The current project is an independently runnable MVP static front end, focused on validating the mobile quoting flow, rule calculation and abnormal quote states."** **Its core features read verbatim**: **"The three lines can be selected independently or quoted in combination."**; **"Public liability and food-safety liability automatically match a premium coefficient by operating area."**; **"Employer liability is calculated from the protection plan, headcount per role and a minimum eight-person underwriting threshold."**; **"Supports result states including normal quote, partial quote, manual quote and not eligible for underwriting."**; **"Displays liability limits, deductible conditions, application materials and the corresponding handling prompts."**; **"Session drafts save progress so work continues after a page refresh."**; **"Adapted for mobile input, soft-keyboard occlusion, bottom safe areas and touch interaction."**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ The three Chinese line names and their rating dimensions, read verbatim, are the entry’s most directly useful point for students of Chinese insurance practice** — **public liability (coefficient matched by operating area)**, **food-safety liability (likewise)** and **employer liability (protection plan, headcount per role and a minimum eight-person underwriting threshold)**. ⭐⭐ **"Minimum eight to underwrite" is itself a concrete underwriting constraint** (**employer liability normally sets a minimum headcount for small employers**), **and "premium coefficient matched by operating area" is the typical rate structure for premises liability**; **for students unfamiliar with Chinese commercial lines, those three points are a minimal sample linking line, risk exposure and rating driver** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the three lines’ rate structures are as described in the Chinese market — no insurer terms or regulatory rate table were consulted**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ "The quoting engine is a pure TypeScript module decoupled from the UI, with rule data managed by version" is the entry’s most notable engineering statement** — it reads verbatim as above. ⭐⭐ **The sentence carries two points**: **the engine is decoupled from the interface, so rules can be tested and replaced independently**; **and rule data is version-managed, so "which version of the rules produced this quote" becomes answerable**. **Its README also states verbatim that the current rule version is `mvp-1.1`** and **links two openable files directly**: the premium rule write-up (`docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md`) and the structured rule configuration (`docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json`) ⭐⭐ **and both were measured present by raw probe (HTTP 200) — so the rule explanation and the machine-readable rule data are published together** (**⚠️ their contents were not read, so no premium formula, coefficient value or underwriting boundary is restated**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Among the four result states, "manual quote" and "not eligible for underwriting" are this round’s central sample** — verbatim: **"Supports result states including normal quote, partial quote, manual quote and not eligible for underwriting."** ⭐⭐ **A quoting system therefore does not have only one way out: it may quote part, refer to a human, or state outright that the risk cannot be written under standard rules** — **cognate with a discipline that recurs across this site** (**flagging rather than blocking in round 329’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]], round 331’s [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]], this round’s `answer_status` in [[insurance-rag-assistant]], and the four states in [[claimlens]]**); **what is distinctive here is applying that set of states at the quoting stage rather than at underwriting or claims — saying "this cannot be quoted under standard rules" while the customer is merely asking for a price** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the four-state design matches any insurer’s real quoting flow**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its "Current limitations" section lists five items verbatim, the most direct form of this round’s theme** — **first**: **"The MVP supports single-store quoting only and does not handle consolidated quoting across multiple stores."**; **second**: **"Employee age conditions are verified at formal application; the current page does not collect employee age details."**; **third**: **"Customer lead capture, a database, employee personalisation and an admin backend are not yet connected."**; **fourth**: **"Quote calculation happens in the browser; when quotes are saved in future the server must recompute them from the inputs and the rule version."**; **fifth**: **"The business phone number shown on the results page is a demo number and cannot serve as a formal enquiry channel."** ⭐⭐⭐ **The fourth deserves separate note: it points out that a client-computed price, once saved, must be recomputed server-side from "inputs plus rule version" — preventing a browser-side quote from being treated as an authoritative record**; **for students building insurance systems that is an easily overlooked constraint with direct auditability consequences** (**readable with round 331’s [[paco-uw]], where editing a rule changes how past quotes would re-evaluate — both address the time relationship between a quote and a rule version**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its disclaimer reads verbatim and lists specifically what it does not replace** — **"This project is for premium estimation at the consultation stage only; it does not replace the insurance core system, formal underwriting or formal policy issuance. Final coverage, premium and terms are subject to the insurer’s review and the formal policy."** ⭐⭐ **The three items together bound what the estimate cannot be used for** (**not a core system, not underwriting, not issuance**), **and for students building quoting systems it is a sample of putting "the output is not a promise" into business language** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the disclaimer has legal effect in any jurisdiction**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its stack and engineering configuration read verbatim and are checkable**: **Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Hook Form, Zod, Vitest and Playwright**; **two commands verbatim**: **`npm run check` (lint, type checking, unit tests and the static build)** and **`npm run test:e2e`**; **the static build output goes to `out/`** and **can be deployed to any static host**; ⭐ **unit tests and end-to-end tests are separated, and the static build is part of `check`** (**⚠️ neither was run**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its mobile adaptations read verbatim and name specific items**: **"adapted for mobile input, soft-keyboard occlusion, bottom safe areas and touch interaction"** — ⭐ **soft-keyboard occlusion and bottom safe areas are two things that genuinely break in real mobile quoting flows** (**for students building mobile insurance journeys, such details usually live outside the requirements document and only surface after launch**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its documentation structure reads verbatim and includes three design documents**: **technology selection** (architecture, static-export approach and future direction), **MVP development and acceptance** (current functional scope, test approach and known limitations), and **mobile UX design notes** (mobile information hierarchy and interaction principles), **alongside the premium rule write-up and structured rule configuration** ⭐⭐ **The three-part pairing of functional scope, test approach and known limitations is a delivery structure students can copy directly**. **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s quoting-engine and Chinese insurance entries**: [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]], [[openrater]], [[ratecraft]], [[insurance-pricing-demo]], [[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]], [[insurance-actuarial-cn]], [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]], [[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]], [[ruc-nonlife-actuarial]] and [[insurance-governance]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ The licence situation here is a third form, and the author states it proactively**: **the README’s closing section reads verbatim "This repository currently has no open-source licence attached. The public content is for viewing and discussion only; copying, modification or distribution without permission is not permitted."** — **not mere silence but an explicit reservation of all rights** (**⚠️ the entry therefore advises that copying, modifying or distributing its content requires prior authorisation**; **⚠️ this differs from the two forms recorded earlier: [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]], [[insurerisk]] and [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] claim a licence with no licence file (a mismatch between claim and fact), while [[claim-ops]] and [[paco-uw]] make no statement at all — this one explicitly declares the absence**; **the user risk is similar across all three but this one is the most determinable**); **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, and the README’s full 3,310 bytes covering its positioning, six core features, stack, run and test commands, business rules and disclaimer, five current limitations, related-document index and licence statement**, **and confirmed by raw probe that three key files exist (HTTP 200)**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, `npm install`, run `npm run dev`, `check` or `test:e2e`, read the contents of any file under `docs/` (including the rule write-up and rule JSON), read any component source, or view its interface or run it on a mobile device**, so **its premium formulas, coefficient values, underwriting boundaries, state decision conditions and any quote result cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether its rating dimensions for the three lines match any Chinese insurer’s actual terms or rates was not verified** — **no insurer terms, regulatory rate table or industry model wording was consulted**; **the entry records only that the README describes them so**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The decision rules and thresholds behind its four result states were not verified** (**the rule JSON was not read**); **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether "rule data managed by version" is actually implemented was not verified** (**the README says the current version is `mvp-1.1`**), **nor whether "the quoting engine is decoupled from the UI" holds in the code**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ The completeness and accuracy of its two Chinese rule documents were not verified** — **⚠️ their existence is confirmed at HTTP 200 but their contents were not read**; **⑦ ⭐ Whether its mobile adaptations actually take effect was not verified**; **⑧ ⭐ Whether its static build successfully produces `out/` was not verified**; **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ That the business phone number is a demo number is stated by the author**, and **the entry does not claim the page is usable for any real customer enquiry or lead capture**; **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ The project describes itself as an MVP static front end for consultation-stage premium estimation and explicitly does not replace the core system, formal underwriting or issuance**, **so the entry does not claim it is usable for any real quoting, underwriting, binding or regulatory purpose**; **⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ Its rule data may change by version and is demonstrative**, **so no version’s rules are claimed usable for real pricing**; **⑫ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created 2026-09-07 and pushed 2026-09-10**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**;
